label: Hide Single Toolbar Icon
description: Hide icons in the URL bar when using a single toolbar.

label: Show Titlebar
description: Show the titlebar when hovering over the window.

label: Show Workspace Name
description: Show the current workspace name indicator.

description: Enable the Bubble Clean folder styling.

description: Use a more compact URL bar when multiple toolbars are enabled.

description: Add a background to the URL bar when using multiple toolbars.

label: Show Extensions on Hover
description: Hide extension buttons until the extension area is hovered.
